title: Uniform measure of a finite event
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty measurable space with measurable singletons, and let $A\subseteq\Omega$. The uniform probability measure of $A$ is $|A|/|\Omega|$, where $|A|$ denotes the cardinality of $A$.
